name: Trucks | Colombia Simulator | Bucaramanga
desc:
------------- Last update -------------
- New Truck Tractor System and modifications for trucks and tractors.

- New areas on the existing map.
- Bug fix.

Get ready to immerse yourself in a unique experience inspired by Bucaramanga, where you don't just play... you live every moment!

Choose your path and create your own story:

🧍 Citizen: Freely explore the map, buy vehicles, customize them, and live your own adventure in the city by making friends and creating gangs.

🚨 Police: Put the city in order, arrest criminals. 

💼 Worker: Earn money by performing various jobs available in the city such as bus driver, truck driver, delivery driver, taxi driver. 

Any use of exploits will be penalized with a permanent ban.

- In development by juandiego66
